run_camera_viewer: run the Spot camera viewer to display HAND_COLOR camera feed in a window
run_no_display: run the camera viewer in headless mode with the --no-display flag to skip GUI
run_quality_arg: run the camera viewer with a custom image quality level using the --quality argument
review_main_function: review the main function that loops to capture, process, and display Spot camera images
refactor_depth_scaling: refactor the depth image scaling logic to support configurable MAX_HAND_DEPTH and MAX_HEAD_DEPTH values
